name: How long does it take to install a new bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional installation for a standard, pre-assembled vanity typically takes 2 to 4 hours if plumbing lines line up properly. If the project requires moving rough-in plumbing, repairing drywall, or custom-fitting a larger cabinet, the work can extend to a full day or more. Timeline changes often depend on whether your current shutoff valves need replacement or if the wall behind the old vanity shows hidden moisture damage. Once the vanity is secured and plumbed, allowing silicone adhesive and caulk around the sink basin to cure usually requires an additional 12 to 24 hours before heavy water use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing a standard replacement vanity typically takes 2 to 4 hours. Custom units or moving plumbing lines can extend the project to a full day or more.
